terms.comment: Joy that is felt and shown, gladness (Lewis & Short: “esp. unrestrained joyfulness”); quieter inward joy is gaudium (see joy).
Happiness as a lucky state of life, not a feeling.

evidence: Lewis & Short: “a word coined by Cic.”
terms.comment: The philosopher’s happy life, and in Christian Latin blessedness; Traupman’s happiness.

evidence: Lewis & Short: “ante-class. for the class. hilaritās”

phrases.english: the elections filled me with joy

phrases.latin: ex summā laetitiā atque lasciviā repente omnēs trīstitia invāsit
phrases.english: after the greatest joy and high spirits, sadness suddenly seized them all

sources: Lewis & Short: laetitia · Lewis & Short: felicitas · Lewis & Short: beatitudo
